fundamentals.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through two segments, Cloud & Networking and Industrial Tech. The Cloud & Networking segment offers optical and photonic chips, components, modules, and subsystems supplied to cloud data center operators, AI/ML infrastructure providers, and network equipment manufacturer customers that are building cloud data centers and network infrastructures. Its Industrial Tech segment provides short-pulse solid-state lasers, kilowatt-class fiber lasers, diode lasers, and gas lasers that serves the semiconductor device, solar cell, display, and electric vehicle and battery manufacturing markets. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing company with strong margins and high valuation multiples, balanced by significant debt and a recent earnings beat.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 4.6%; next earnings date is 2026-05-05.
positives: Revenue growth 90.1% YoY and analyst estimates of 236.6% for the current quarter and 300.7% for the fiscal year indicate explosive growth.
Gross margin at 40.8%, operating margin at 21.8%, and profit margin at 17.7% are strong.
Return on equity at 22.8% is robust.
PEG ratio of 0.63 suggests growth may justify the high P/E.
Last quarter's EPS beat estimates by 4.6%.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 156.59 and Forward P/E of 49.49 are very high.
Price/Book of 75.54 and Price/Sales of 28.00 are also elevated.
Debt/Equity ratio of 111.44 and total debt slightly exceeding total cash indicate significant leverage.
Free cash flow of $93.35M is modest relative to market cap.
Beta of 1.53 suggests higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) saw its shares surge 13.7% on June 2nd, contributing to a broader optics rally, with Yahoo Finance noting the stock's upswing has impacted some funds. The company's recent performance and its potential benefit from increased AI spending by tech giants like Google have fueled investor interest, leading to questions about whether it's too late to invest after a significant price jump. The stock's recent performance is notable given its last reported quarter beat EPS estimates.
